summary: Robert "Bob" Rozman, 81, an Irwin resident and long-time Crested Butte local, died apparently during the week's major snowstorm while headed back to his Irwin cabin; an Irwin resident discovered his body partially covered in snow on a roadway in the Irwin Townsite ~1 p.m. Sunday December 12; Crested Butte Mountain Rescue mobilized ~1:15 p.m. — six members plus Mt. Crested Butte police and the county coroner responded on snowmobiles and a tracked Polaris Ranger UTV and brought him down from the townsite that afternoon; coroner autopsy pending, preliminary finding natural death.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Rescue + Mt. Crested Butte Police + Gunnison County Coroner
